_comment: Access guard allowlist. Every entry MUST carry a justification — this file is reviewed like code. Shape per detector below. Paths are repo-relative, forward-slash.

lowestTierDefault._comment: Historical migrations predating the 2026-07-21 'personal' rename/policy are exempt by filename. New entries here require a dated justification, not just a filename.

example.justification: Applied before 2026-07-21 visibility policy; grandfathered, do not edit.

activeOrgAccess._comment: File-level or file:line-level suppressions for detector 2 (active-org reads inside access-decision files).

example.justification: Reads active org only for a UI label, not an access decision — grep context above/below confirms no .eq(...) gate follows.

handRolledLadder._comment: Files outside utils/permissions/** that legitimately compare permission_level strings (e.g. read-only display formatting, not an access decision).

example.justification: Cosmetic label mapping only, never gates a read/write; the real check happens via iam.has_access upstream.

bareRlsList._comment: List-shaped Supabase reads in features/**/{service,services,redux}/** that are intentionally unscoped (e.g. genuinely public reference data, or scope handled by a wrapping RPC not visible in this chain).

example.justification: Public model catalog, world-readable by design, RLS enforces read-only; no owner/org scope applies.
